macro_event.direction: sign(score); positive is gold-supportive/up context and negative is gold-adverse/down context
macro_event.role: event-triggered directional hazard modifier; not continuous daily direction vote

market_shock.concordance: market shock direction sign must equal strong macro score sign

daily_mapping.rule: event released on a governed NY17 role-replay calendar date is available as context for that date's completed daily origin; events outside available role-replay dates map to the first role-replay date on or after release calendar date only if the release precedes that origin
daily_mapping.same_day_lead: lead 0 if event context first appears on the objective break date

role_preserving_integration.event_opposite_regime: strong macro direction is opposite the current pre-break regime
role_preserving_integration.event_concordant_opposite_regime: event_opposite_regime AND concordant Market Shock V3 within 0-10 minutes
role_preserving_integration.core_break_alert_event: core_break_alert OR (core_weakening AND event_opposite_regime) OR event_concordant_opposite_regime
